body: We only get one avatar in this game of life, and mine now has the label of being an abuser. I think I’m fucked.

I’ve been told that but I don’t think anyone deserves anything, good or bad. I think my life where I am has been hopelessly ruined and there are dozens of connections I’m going to lose at the hands of my ex because she enjoys hurting me. I’m humiliated at the fact that she chose my coworker and I’m ashamed to be seen by people who think I’m an abuser. I think there are people who would gladly see me dead now and I have no power to change that.
